title: Batch Metal rigid solver dispatches
requires: macOS with the production Metal toolchain and a physical Apple GPU; access to iPad Metal validation for platform qualification
scope: Replace the Metal fixed-tick rigid solver's body-count-sized color dispatch loop with bounded batched device work. Retain shared Slang equations, the sole production schedule, eight algebraic sweeps and one time advance. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-DISPATCH-REDUCTION.md and docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: Before changing dispatch encoding, record numerical launch ceilings for fixed 8/64/128/386-body fixtures and sparse-capacity cases in an independently reviewed test artifact. The ceilings must reject the audited 8*(body_count+1)+6 solve graph (including 1038 launches at 128 bodies and 3102 at 386); do not derive acceptance limits from the implementation being tested.

Batch work over actual active bodies/constraints without reserving a host dispatch for every possible body/color in every sweep. Empty colors must not create thousands of issued no-op commands; moving the same loop to an indirect command buffer alone does not establish reduction.

Retain one 1/60 advance, one dynamic BVH build/publication, eight rigid sweeps, generation-safe reset/rollback and correct device dependencies. No phase-local host count readback, global GPU wait, serial CPU physics, hidden substep, reduced workload or weakened physical tolerance may replace batching.

Measure actual native compute dispatches including no-op/indirect commands, workgroups, barriers and CPU/GPU time through the public production path on a physical Apple GPU. Compare identical inputs with the retained pre-fix revision; preserve independent rigid contact/joint, cold-start and sustained quality checks.

Portable regression tests reject the original per-body launch scaling and reconcile scheduler statistics with adapter-issued counts. Cross-adapter compilation and the shared solver tests pass; installed Mac/iPad Gallery comparison is completed by F8-56.
evidence: PASS: public production counters reduced total dispatches 112 to 35 and domain dispatches 88 to 11 with zero host waits/readbacks; docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-54-metal-rigid-dispatch-batching.json

PASS: ctest --test-dir build-macos-metal-preview --repeat until-fail:20 -R parallel-mater-slang-metal-realtime-tests; 20 cold-start processes; docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-54-metal-rigid-dispatch-batching.json

PASS: cmake --build --preset macos-metal-preview, cmake --build --preset ipad-ci, and ctest --preset sdk-cpu; macOS arm64, iPhoneOS 26.5 arm64, CPU reference; docs/roadmap/F8-54-METAL-RIGID-DISPATCH-BATCHING.md
